name: loop
facts: One unit's cycle is brief, build, gauntlet, judge, then passing or one named gap (z2s/execute.py module docstring)
The gauntlet is run by the orchestrator itself, so its exit status is observed rather than reported (z2s/execute.py prove, status.ran)
The judge is a second worker and its brief never carries the builder's report (z2s/execute.py judgement, FR-EXE-14)
A retry is briefed with the single gap the last judgement named, and a fresh judge sees it (z2s/execute.py ledger gaps)
Attempts are bounded: exhausting the configured limit blocks the unit and records the reason (z2s/execute.py short, config attempts)
A unit that passes has its machine-checkable criteria ticked and is committed on its own (z2s/execute.py attempt, status.tick, status.commit)
budget_cuts: The report contract check (z2s/execute.py check_report) is a real step between the build and the gauntlet: a report must show a check seen failing before the work existed, and name the command that proved each criterion. It is folded into the gauntlet decision here because the flowchart budget is 9 steps and it shares that decision's outcome.

Concurrency is not drawn. Units with disjoint declared write sets run at the same time up to a ceiling, and a unit declaring no write set runs alone (M11-04). That is a property of the run, not of one unit's cycle, and it would need its own figure.
